meta.rule: If more than 23% of a station's weekday boardings are in the morning peak (07-09) and fewer than 18% are transfers, it is a Morning departure station, unless over 41% fall in the evening peak (16-19), which makes it Evening departure. If the morning share is 23% or less: up to 40% in the evening peak means All-day & weekend; above 40% means Evening departure, or Transfer hub when more than 14% of boardings are transfers. Stations with a strong morning peak and more than 18% transfers are Transfer hubs when over 7% of weekday boardings come after 20:00, otherwise Morning departure.
